title: NYC Bare-Earth Terrain Elevation
text: Bare-earth digital elevation model New York City, derived City’s 1-foot 2010 LiDAR data. package ships mean-aggregated 50-foot 100-foot GeoTIFFs masked borough boundaries, plus small contour sf object ggplot2 overlays.

title: NYC Bare-Earth Terrain Elevation
text: City New York, 1-foot Digital Elevation Model (DEM): https://data.cityofnewyork.us/City-Government/1-foot-Digital-Elevation-Model-DEM-/dpc8-z3jc. Bare-earth, hydro-flattened raster derived 2010 LiDAR. Vertical datum NAVD88, units feet. CRS EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island, ftUS).

title: Get the NYC bare-earth elevation raster at 100ft or 50ft resolution — nyc_terrain_100ft
text: Returns terra::SpatRaster bare-earth elevation feet sea level (NAVD88), masked New York City borough boundaries. single layer named elev. CRS EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island, ftUS). Cells outside city boundary NA.

text: Contour lines derived 100-foot bare-earth Digital Elevation Model. Useful lightweight elevation overlay ggplot2 maps. EPSG:2263, NAD83 / New York Long Island (ftUS).

nycterrain 0.0.1.9000
text: Initial release bare-earth elevation data New York City, derived City’s 1-foot 2010 LiDAR DEM. Added nyc_terrain_100ft() nyc_terrain_50ft() accessor functions returning terra::SpatRaster objects masked borough boundaries. Added nyc_terrain_path() direct file access. Added nyc_terrain_contours_sf, 50-level contour dataset derived 100ft DEM use ggplot2 overlay.
